reviews.classification: later delivery / qualified proof artifact / artifact provenance / superseded rationale
reviews.disposition:
Historical bounded two-life return delivery under AD10/AD12/AD36/AD42/AD43 and WER. This later receipt supplies the missing original Village-return consumer from the earlier launch-start checkpoint. Branching preserves the actual Village boundary before in-place Tingen enrollment; resume restores102 Village money and its no-LOTM slice, then480-pence Tingen money/exact slice on reciprocal return. Those are separate life snapshots/resources, not a cross-world coin conversion or duplicated purse. A new connection uses the existing record; an older Tingen save with no Village snapshot does not fabricate a prior life.

The returnable route and no-port/non-adult/challenge in-place fallback have different terms. A failed branch retains the Village state. Resumed Tingen's continuation UI defect was repaired by separating writable continuation from rewind-only eligibility; allowing ordinary continuation does not enable Tingen rewind. New branch itself has no reload while persistence/return restoration retains its native transition path. The exact two-life snapshot size measurements motivate a later file-storage question, not proof of arbitrary many-life storage cost or a selected migration.

Fresh rebuilt headless route and literal import across both lives support this specific snapshot-based return at the named build. No separate MCP resume hop was played; the seeded UUID consumption workaround belongs to the harness, not actual browser behavior. Matrix1920/1536 ×14/21 and3497 full tests retain their original scopes, not all GP knowledge/body/companion/duty reconciliation or arbitrary current continuing-self merge. Old paused snapshots are not automatic carriers for every later learned ability or independently aging body. This whole checkpoint review opens no source, save, private artifact or browser, and supplies no current installation/persistence proof. Human review is optional; deferred friendly life name/date/money/files remain distinct old follow-ups.

reviews.classification: later delivery / qualified proof artifact / artifact provenance / superseded rationale
reviews.disposition:
Historical13-act continuation with materially qualified proof copy, under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve selected ch62–64 scenes and unbuilt unwitnessed passages,954 labelled minutes/16804→17758 clock, and unstated Monday-night/Tuesday times as fills. The later C1 client entries and late Anna settlement are actual named consumers in this receipt, superseding KJ3AB's then-anna-only fallback for these two selected clients. That does not establish every paid story client or source-authorized club shares. The money calculation799−2+8+12=817 is coherent; Glacis1/Joyce1.5 shares remain listed/inferred debt, not source-shown payments. Anna's net10 fact is a disclosed correction from the older12 note. Unstated fares/stamps do not invent numerical debits.

Only dream uses the actual B3 switch-on/spend/exhaustion path; two other source switch-ons are factual fallbacks because the model's single-cycle/pool/exhaustion semantics do not fit them. Night clearing exhaustion does not claim the three source uses are implemented. A .real method prerequisite is a concrete bounded reader, not newly verified full divination. R5/B8/B11/G17 and acting's later half remain unexercised. Calling guesses the caller without heard content or confirmed rite; other actors' remote actions remain outside lead knowledge.

The successful run is on a proof copy stripped of four B8 proof acts and later-window rows. The repo campaign pack still contained those interfering acts, so passing proof does not establish normal next-act ordering on the live shared pack. Keep boot-timeout and first-act-order failures separate from the final successful13-act run; one run in the table means the final accepted route, not no prior attempts. A clean pinned master bundle plus modified copied pack has its own identity; copied files differ from symlinks/live source. No RESUME join, repeat reload after import,14/21 visual, current shared-dist or whole-campaign claim follows. The before-commit rules command lacks a result field here. Carriage place/use, home-ID mismatch and owed-share settlement remain explicit consumers/gaps. This full receipt review inspects no private proof pack, runtime, current source or actual saved game.

reviews.classification: later delivery / qualified proof artifact / artifact provenance / superseded rationale
reviews.disposition:
Full61-row artifact/provenance table review under AD32/AD35/AD36. D2–D4 supersede older metadata-only acquisition state for selected artifacts, not for semantic reading/play. Distinguish release JAR, CurseForge release, pinned default-branch source archive, official server archive and mrpack exports; a source commit need not correspond to the release and external dependencies were not recursively fetched. Archive member/filename counts do not certify complete mechanics. Thirty-eight publisher Modrinth hashes and61 CRC/receipt checks are different assurance layers, not61 independent publisher equivalence certificates. Hash prefixes shown in this report are navigation; actual bytes/full hashes remain artifact receipts.

Preserve resolved identity choices: original Roguelike Dungeons/Totemic sources replace uncertain same-title matches, Factory Tech's official GitLab source route corrects a failed guessed GitHub route, Blightfall comes from its official server link, and MineColonies/Antimatter Chemistry/Cuboid Outpost/MeatballCraft use specified source links. Cabricality remains a distinct inspired pack, not a replacement for original Above and Beyond. Later downloaded Prominence bytes supersede the earlier sample-size stop without making it installed or semantically reviewed. Table arithmetic/counts are separately checked on this actually read table, not by fetching or rehashing a corpus here.

The seven-auditor dispatch banner is historical dispatch, not proof that readers are active now or all61 reports completed. It authorizes no new agents/acquisition/game launch in this reconciliation. All actual artifacts remain ignored private research, distinct from public assets/licensing for reuse. A61-target source corpus can contain incompatible Minecraft versions/loaders without being one playable pack. This full report read inspects neither underlying archives/member lists nor receipt/index JSON, code, game, UI or personal saves; it adds no semantic-source/gameplay/installation proof.

reviews.classification: later delivery / qualified proof artifact / artifact provenance / superseded rationale
reviews.disposition:
Historical Q1 progression prototype and later corrections under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43. Read the candidate comparison, authored dials, original switching implementation, compatibility/test/journey gaps and final later-lane note. The duplicated roughly-one-year/X3 rationale is explicitly wrong relative to this file's corrected F18/X4 row and final note. Retire that duplicate from current reasoning with exact original text in amendments; retain the four-act count as authored rather than canon. Corpse Collector acts, Hale's attention,25/60-minute durations and assessment stand-in are source-inspired prototype choices, not the source acting text or a universal legal progression schedule.

The final note explicitly supersedes Q1's original two-pathway validator wall with a recorded-cause rule from the lives checkpoint. Keep old three-level command/state/UI restrictions as history of what Q1 built, not a standing claim that all switching is impossible. No fresh primary-source or current runtime validation occurs here. The comparison's local source-availability reasons choose a bounded pilot; they do not ban Spectator/Sleepless or every unsupported world pathway. Biological/perceptual capability descriptions still lack actual encounter consumers here, distinct from a real held/ingested progression flag.

Twenty-two engine checks include17 existing/five new; no native binding or full-suite/rules check was run by this lane. The browser plays Corpse Collector through Gravedigger and mid-vigil reload, while Seer only reaches one reading. Loading an already promoted Seer does not exercise fresh6/6 advancement. Q2's later actually read receipt records that specific Clown replay, not an automatic extension of Q1's own evidence. save_to_file/load_progress string restoration is not native exported-file download/file-input Import. DOM text at1920 without screenshots/font checks is not actual14/21 desktop visual proof. No hidden-tab inspection becomes human pacing acceptance.

Pre-change taught/promoted fixtures preserve those backward cases; new Corpse Collector fields remain forward-incompatible to older builds. A fresh origin, deliberate unload-save handling and old disposable test-save deletion describe the original harness, not personal-save access now. Old no-switching labels, short attention/count pacing, code-refactor suggestions and next Q2/Q6 work are historical, not a current rewrite queue. Source law still needs exact reading; current selected engine consumer and native/browser proof govern any later runtime claim.
